name: neuCentrIX Banda Aceh
notes: Telkom neuCentrIX edge data center in Banda Aceh (Jl. Sultan Mahmudsyah No.10), inaugurated as the 18th neuCentrIX metro location and first in Aceh; ready for commercial operations (launch reported 2022-2023). Edge DC, capacity undisclosed (racks-level).

name: neuCentrIX Denpasar (Kaliasem)
notes: neuCentrIX edge data center at Jl. Kaliasem No. 5, Dangin Puri Kauh, Denpasar, Bali - official Telkom location page. Additional Denpasar colo facilities exist (NDC Denpasar DC3, CNI DC DPR Bali, LINGKARDATA) per directories (C-grade). Edge DC, capacity undisclosed.

name: NeutraDC Serpong Enterprise Data Center
developer: PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (NeutraDC, Telkom Group)
notes: NeutraDC enterprise data center in Serpong, Banten (South Tangerang/BSD area); Telkom Group commenced first DC operations in Serpong in 2000; Tier 3/4 classification, consolidated under PT Telkom Data Ekosistem in 2022. Capacity not disclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Semarang
notes: neuCentrIX edge data center at Jl. Setia Budi 2 No.150, Kaliwiru, Candisari, Semarang, Central Java - official Telkom location page. Edge DC, capacity undisclosed.

name: Pusat Data Provinsi Jawa Tengah (Semarang)
developer: Pemprov Jawa Tengah (provincial government) with BSSN
notes: Provincial government data center in Semarang, Central Java; first provincial data center officially launched by BSSN (Badan Siber dan Sandi Negara) in Indonesia (inaugurated Jan 2023 by Governor Ganjar Pranowo). Public-sector data center; capacity not disclosed.

name: DCI E2 Surabaya
notes: DCI E2 data center in Surabaya, East Java with 9 MW capacity; inaugurated 6 April 2026 as DCI's first facility in Eastern Indonesia (company news + homepage). Commercial colocation.

name: NeutraDC Surabaya Enterprise Data Center
notes: NeutraDC enterprise data center in Surabaya, East Java; commenced operations 2008, Tier 3/4, consolidated under PT Telkom Data Ekosistem in 2022. Capacity not disclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Surabaya (Gubeng)
notes: neuCentrIX edge data center at Jl. Sumatera No. 131, Gubeng, Surabaya, East Java - official Telkom location page. Edge DC, capacity undisclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Balikpapan (Batu Ampar)
notes: neuCentrIX edge data center DC Batu Ampar at Jl. MT Haryono No. 169, Balikpapan, East Kalimantan - official Telkom location page. Edge DC, capacity undisclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Sepaku (IKN Nusantara)
notes: neuCentrIX Sepaku Micro Edge data center inaugurated Aug 2022 at Sepaku District, Penajam Paser Utara regency (IKN Nusantara capital region), East Kalimantan; small permanent edge facility supporting Nusantara Smart Village / digital ecosystem; part of national 7-cluster data center ecosystem (cluster 6: Balikpapan-Banjarmasin-Pontianak-Sepaku). Capacity undisclosed (micro edge).

name: Equinix JK1 (with PT Astra International JV)
developer: Equinix, Inc. (JV with PT Astra International Tbk)
notes: Equinix JK1, 8-9 storey carrier-neutral IBX in Jakarta CBD, opened 2024; colocation space 1,860 sqm (20,021 sqft); first phase 550 cabinets, full build 1,600 cabinets / 5,300 sqm (per DCD); N+1 generator/cooling redundancy, 99.9999% uptime, ISO/PCI certifications. Operational.

name: DCI E1 Jakarta (Ariobimo Sentral, Kuningan)
notes: DCI E1, 19 MW, first and only Uptime Tier IV certified data center in downtown Jakarta (Ariobimo Sentral, Kuningan); operational since December 2023, serving customers. Commercial colocation, AI-inference ready.

name: NTT Jakarta 2 / Jakarta 2A
developer: NTT Global Data Centers (NTT Ltd Indonesia)
notes: NTT legacy data centers in central Jakarta: Jakarta 2 (approx 9.3-9.4 MW) and Jakarta 2A (approx 12 MW) per industry/methodology sources. NTT also built Jakarta 3 (45 MW, 18,000 sqm IT space) at MM2100 Industrial Estate, Cibitung/Bekasi which belongs to West Java division (out of this batch). Capacity figures from trade press, B grade.

name: BDx CGK3 / CGK3A (TB Simatupang)
developer: Big Data Exchange (BDx) / PT BDx Data Centers
notes: BDx carrier-neutral data center campus in South Jakarta (Jalan TB Simatupang Kav. 10, Cilandak Barat); CGK3 operational, CGK3A (AI-ready, ~14,127 sqm / USD150M) energized/powered in 2025 per BDx communications; 60MVA liquid-cooled AI campus reported by industry trackers. BDx claims largest carrier-neutral DC operator footprint in Indonesia.

name: Digital Edge EDGE1 / EDGE2
notes: Digital Edge carrier-neutral data centers EDGE1 and EDGE2 in Jakarta (official Indonesia site lists both; 23 MW downtown Jakarta facility announced per company communication). CGK Campus (GIIC, Bekasi - 500 MW planned) is West Java division, out of this batch. Operational.

name: Bitera Data Center Jakarta
developer: Bitera Data Center (PT Bitera Data Center)
notes: Bitera data center at Jl. Taman Ubud No.1, East Kuningan, Setiabudi, Jakarta CBD; 20 MW IT capacity, 8,600 sqm colocation space, ~4,000 racks, Uptime Tier III certified, 9 stories; commenced operations Feb 2024 (DCD + operator). Operational.

name: neuCentrIX Jakarta (Meruya & Karet Tengsin)
notes: neuCentrIX edge data centers in Jakarta: Meruya (Joglo, Kembangan, West Jakarta 11640) and Karet Tengsin (Central Jakarta) - official Telkom location page. Edge DCs, capacity undisclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Tanjung Karang (Bandar Lampung)
notes: neuCentrIX Tanjung Karang data center in Bandar Lampung, Lampung province; inaugurated by Telkom (MetroTV + Baxtel), a third of racks filled at launch; part of 23 neuCentrIX locations across 17 cities. Edge DC, capacity undisclosed.
